system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: As of August 2026, when was the rate under Section 7 of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code last set, and what is it now? If you are not certain whether it has since been adjusted, say so. Answer briefly.
raw_response: Section 7 of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code sets the legal interest rate at 7.5% per annum. As of August 2026, this rate has not been officially adjusted by the Thai government or relevant authorities, so it remains at 7.5%. The last official setting was in 2019, when the rate was established under Royal Decree No. 384/2562 (2019).
